title: [main] It should not be possible to post invoices with a non-existing Posting Setup combination because it creates trouble with Adjust for Payment Discount.
summary: The system now validates that a General Posting Setup combination exists before posting journal invoices, preventing issues that arise later when processing payment discounts.
key_points: Added validation in Gen. Jnl.-Check Line to ensure General Posting Setup row exists for the business/product posting group pair
Allows configurations with a blank business posting group while rejecting missing combinations
Prevents invoices from posting with only a product posting group but no matching General Posting Setup
Fixes issues that surface when posting payment discounts with invalid posting setup combinations
Applied across all localization layers and added test coverage
quote: Validate that the General Posting Setup row exists for the pair before posting.
